metadata:

  version: 1.0.0
  description: Studio-owned reference fixture.
  provenance:

    revision: 1.0.0

      scientific fidelity claim.
spec:
  systemRef:
    apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
    kind: System
    namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
    name: reference-loop

    apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
    kind: Deployment
    namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
    name: local-reference
  initialConditions:
    stateParameterRef: initial
  steps:
  - id: start-reference
    actionKind: start
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
      name: reference-loop
      element: plant
    timeDomainId: simulation-time
    schedule:
      at: 0
      unit: s
    action:
      operation: reference-response
  observers:
  - id: state-observer
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.process-control
      name: reference-loop
      element: state-flow
    timeDomainId: simulation-time

    payloadSchema: urn:xverse:studio:normalized-scalar:v1

    seed:
      value: 7
      unitSemantics: reference-seed
    parameters:
    - id: target
      valueType: number
      value: 1.0
      unitSemantics: '1'
      mutability: configuration
    - id: gain
      valueType: number
      value: 0.8
      unitSemantics: '1'
      mutability: configuration
    - id: initial
      valueType: number
      value: 0.0
      unitSemantics: '1'
      mutability: configuration
    - id: duration
      valueType: number
      value: 5
      unitSemantics: s
      mutability: configuration
    - id: timestep
      valueType: number
      value: 1
      unitSemantics: s
      mutability: configuration
    - id: fault
      valueType: string
      value: none
      unitSemantics: '1'
      mutability: configuration
    fidelityLimitations:
    - Normalized first-order scalar response only; no automotive, industrial, 
      simulator or hardware fidelity.
  io.xverse.studio.experiments:
    version: '1.0'
    definitions:
    - evaluationId: state-within-bound
      version: '1.0'
      kind: assertion
      name: Reference state within bound
      systemRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.process-control/system/reference-loop
      scenarioRef: 
        xdl://org.xverse.studio.process-control/scenario/reference-response
      coveragePolicy: complete
      window:
        clockDomainRef: simulation-time
        startTick: '0'
        endTick: '5000000'
      expression:
        kind: compare
        operator: le
        left:
          kind: aggregate
          operator: max
          input:
            kind: signal
            observerRef: state-observer
            field: value
        right:
          kind: literal
          value: 1.2
          unit: '1'
      description: Owned model check only. Changing the time horizon can make 
        coverage indeterminate.
